about: Labelled messages for the keyword gates (RetrievalPlan web gate, NewsIntent, ToolAliases). web: should the Auto gate search without asking the model? news: is it a news briefing/topic request? Messages were written to cover everyday phrasing, not tuned to the regexes. Scored by test/keyword_gate_eval_test.dart. web_holdout was written after the lists were tuned and is never tuned against: it is the honest estimate. web_holdout2 was written on 2026-09-24 before the category lists (web_terms.dart) existed and is never tuned against. web_negatives (2026-09-24) are general-knowledge and writing requests full of trap words, written after the category lists to catch over-broad entries. web_phone_misses (2026-09-24) are questions sent to the web by hand from the phone (Settings > Reasoning & search log) plus paraphrases; web_negatives gained person-word traps the same day. Since 2026-10-19 how-to questions always search when web search is on, so the how-to items are labelled web: true.
